servicesTitle: Inside, outside, and every detail between.
servicesIntro: From a deep interior clean to multi-stage paint correction, with high-quality products for every surface.

services.name: Full Detail
services.text: Our most popular package: interior and exterior together, finished with a 3-month paint sealant.

services.name: Full Refresh Detail
services.text: For vehicles that need extra attention: steam cleaning, shampoo and heated extraction, clay bar and a 6-month paint sealant.

services.name: Interior Refresh
services.text: Deep-cleans seats, carpets and every crevice so the cabin feels brand-new again.

services.name: Exterior Detail
services.text: Hand wash, polish and paint protection, so the finish sparkles under the desert sun.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Takes out swirl marks, light scratches and oxidation from the Nevada sun.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: Professional coating that locks in long-term protection for your finish.

why.name: Built for the desert
why.text: Products and methods chosen to protect your vehicle from Nevada sun, blowing dust and everyday grime.

why.name: Honest pricing
why.text: Packages are sized to your exact vehicle. No hidden fees, no upselling pressure.

why.name: Flexible plans
why.text: Choose a one-time clean or regular maintenance.

whyTitle: The detail is in the name.
howTitle: Book it. We show up. You drive off shining.
